name: spotlight-knockout
title: Spotlight Knockout
description: A wall of dark type with a spotlight hole punched through it: the headline sits underneath and is only legible inside a radial mask that tracks the pointer — reading becomes a searchlight act.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Pointer Mask Follow: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
